full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white science-fiction illustration shows a uniformed man seated in the lower left foreground beside sleek spacecraft on a barren rocky plain. He is drawn in profile facing right, with short dark hair, a firm expression, and a pale high-collared jacket bearing a round dark insignia on the upper sleeve. His arms rest close to his bent knees, and the strong dark contour of his body anchors the near edge. To his right, a long low aircraft or spacecraft sits across the middle ground, its pointed nose extending left and a large dark rectangular engine opening facing the viewer at the right. A clear rounded cockpit rises above the fuselage. A smaller craft is parked behind it. Above the man, a broad disk-shaped vehicle hovers against a star-speckled black sky; its pale top catches light, while the underside is shaded by short ink marks. A narrow wing or another object enters from the far left edge. In the distance at right, white cylindrical and domed structures rise between rugged stone walls, their simple geometric masses contrasting with the eroded cliffs. A huge cratered planet curves across the upper right, partly cut by the frame, and a small crescent hangs near the top center. Dark rock cliffs close in at both sides, leaving an opening toward the bright distant settlement. The foreground ground is pale and coarse, crossed by sparse low shadows and little rocky fragments. Bright white planes and dense black pools are shaped by fine pen hatching, engraved texture, and carefully modeled gradients. The light seems to come from the upper left, making the craft, buildings, and man's jacket luminous while cliffs and sky remain dark. The arrangement combines a low grounded viewpoint with enormous celestial scale, filling the scene with crisp adventure-story detail and deep black-white contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白科幻插画描绘一名制服男子坐在荒凉岩石平原的左下前景，身旁有流线型飞船。他侧身朝右，短黑发、神情坚毅，穿浅色高领外套，上臂有圆形深色徽章。双臂靠在弯曲膝边，身体有力的深暗轮廓锚住近侧。右边一架低矮而修长的飞行器或飞船横在中景，尖头向左伸，右侧一处大而深暗的矩形发动机开口朝向观者。圆润透明驾驶舱隆起在机身上方。它后面还停着一艘较小飞船。男子上方，一架宽阔圆盘状飞行器悬在布满星点的黑色天空前；浅色上表面受光，底面由短墨线压暗。一片窄翼或别的物体从画面最左侧进入。右侧远处，白色圆柱建筑和穹顶在粗糙石壁之间升起，简单几何大块与受侵蚀悬崖形成对照。一颗巨大的坑纹行星弯过右上，被画框部分裁掉，顶端中央附近还有一弯小月。深色岩壁从两侧围合，留一道通往明亮远处建筑的开口。前景土地浅而粗，有稀疏低影和小岩石碎块。明白平面与浓黑暗池由细钢笔排线、刻印般纹理和仔细塑造的渐层构成。光似乎来自左上，使飞船、建筑和男子外套发亮，悬崖与天空保持深暗。构图把低处扎实视点与巨大的天体尺度结合，用清晰冒险故事细节和深重黑白对比填满场景。
style_prompt_en: Monochrome pen illustration sets luminous white shapes against dense black fields, with fine hatching and engraved marks describing the intermediate volume. Long streamlined contours cross sturdy geometric blocks, while curved masses at very different scales create dramatic depth. Foreground forms stay crisp and heavily outlined; distant structures become simpler and paler without vanishing entirely. Small bright specks punctuate the upper darkness, and rough granular texture keeps the lower pale area from looking blank. Directional light selects hard edges and rounded highlights, leaving deep pools of shadow beneath them. The composition balances one strong near silhouette with broad horizontal motion and an immense high curved counterform, producing a vivid, orderly visual momentum.
style_prompt_zh: 单色钢笔插画以发亮白形对着浓黑色域，用细排线与刻印状笔迹描述中间体积。修长流线轮廓穿过稳固几何块，不同尺度的弯曲大形建立戏剧性纵深。前景形态清楚且有厚轮廓，远处结构变得简化、较浅，却没有完全消失。细小亮点刺破上部黑暗，粗颗粒肌理让下方浅色区域不显空白。定向光挑出硬边与圆润亮处，下面留下深暗影池。构图以一枚有力近剪影平衡宽阔横向动势和上方巨大弯形，形成鲜明、有序的视觉动势。
theme_en: A uniformed man beside spacecraft beneath a huge planet
theme_zh: 一名制服男子坐在飞船旁，头顶悬着巨大行星
name: Al Williamson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
